response.sql: SELECT s.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag::text BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.riskeval;

assumptions.assumption: The average is taken over per-scan ratios (gbsize ÷ spanmin for each scan), then averaged within each riskeval group. Rows where gbsize or spanmin is NULL drop out of the average, and a spanmin of 0 is treated as missing so the division does not fail.

chronotag is compared as text by casting it to text, so the bounds are checked lexically in ISO timestamp format, as the request specifies. A timestamp with no fractional seconds would sort differently from one with them.
A NULL riskeval forms its own group in the output rather than being dropped.

alternatives.interpretation: Pooled ratio: the total file size divided by the total scan minutes within each riskeval group, using only scans where both gbsize and spanmin are present, instead of averaging the per-scan ratios.
alternatives.sql: SELECT s.riskeval, SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag::text BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.riskeval;
